tools.description: Search FlutterSDK package documentation (artisan, dusk, magic, telescope, wind). Returns markdown results with full page content up to a token budget. Default: search all packages at their latest version.

packages.description: Optional package filter. Slugs (artisan, dusk, magic, telescope, wind) or composer-style (fluttersdk_wind). Default: all 5.

queries.description: List of search queries. Pass multiple when terminology is ambiguous (e.g. ['toggle', 'switch']). Required.

token_limit.description: Token budget for response. Default 3000, max 100000. Approx chars = tokens × 4.

version.description: Optional version pin, applied to both the pages found and the content served. Default: latest per package. On a miss the series chain falls back and the response header names what was requested.

tools.name: search-docs
tools.title: Search Docs
